checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Poster, story and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'
must.why: Story and poster read '24 October 2027'. The reel title card was not in the frames I was given, only the opening shot.
Both revised pictures are clean. The reel opening frames show no text, but the title card frames are not available.

must.item: All three retain Rooftop Jazz, 7 PM, Atlas Roof, Free entry unaltered
must.why: On the poster, 'free entry' looks like 'ƒree entry' and is clipped at the bottom edge. It is also lowercase. Reel title card not seen.

must.item: Revised assets preserve original designs/layout apart from the date
must.why: The navy and gold art deco design, saxophonist and layout match the originals, and only the date changed. The brief says cream-and-burgundy, but the first pack was navy and gold.

must.item: Two separate images and one 10-second reel in requested ratios
must.why: Two images are present in 9:16 and 2:3. The reel is 9 seconds per the reply and its opening clip is 5.2 s, not 10 s. The clips are reported as having sound, but the reply says the reel has none.

exact_text.read_as: free entry (poster shows 'ƒree entry', clipped at the bottom)

faults.what: The poster's bottom line 'free entry' has a malformed first letter and is cut off at the bottom edge.

The reel's opening shot was remade from scratch. It does not match the original exactly: the framing and motion are different and the saxophonist is larger. The user asked to keep everything else the same.
The reel title card is not shown in the frames, so the date in the reel cannot be confirmed.
The story and poster text is soft and low-resolution, and the small text is wobbly.
The clips have an audio track although the reply says the reel has no sound, and the clip is 5 s, not 10 s.

summary: The date was correctly changed to 24 October 2027 on the story and poster with the design intact, but the poster's 'free entry' line is glitchy and clipped, and the reel's title card could not be verified.
